notes:
Creating a new project: the same folder browser plus a name field. Confirm stays disabled until both a parent folder and a name are chosen.

CHR-831: the name field is labelled "Project name" (was "New folder / project name") so it is not confused with the new "+ New folder" button in the path row, which creates intermediate folders such as ~/work/clients. States: `init-project-dialog-new-folder` (typing) and its `-exists`, `-invalid`, `-permission`, `-created` variants.
